selected_evidence.requirement: Restrict SSH login access to remote-access members
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the effective AllowGroups policy, successful member authentication, explicit AllowGroups rejection of a non-member, and final healthy configuration.
Both commands show opsadmin in the remote-access group and confirm the account remains present and enabled.

Captures the healthy pre-restart baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered SSH service/listener/handshake, unchanged policy checksum and membership, and repeated post-restart member/non-member behavior.

commands.command:
set -eu
test_key=/tmp/remote-access-policy-test-key
deny_user=sshdenycheck
probe_created=0
cleanup_probe() {
  rm -f "$test_key" "$test_key.pub" /tmp/ssh-allow-result /tmp/ssh-deny-result
  rm -f /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys 2>/dev/null || true
  rmdir /home/opsadmin/.ssh 2>/dev/null || true
  if [ "$probe_created" -eq 1 ] && id "$deny_user" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    deluser --remove-home "$deny_user" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi
}
trap cleanup_probe EXIT HUP INT TERM
if id "$deny_user" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  printf '%s\n' 'probe account unexpectedly exists' >&2
  exit 1
fi
rm -f "$test_key" "$test_key.pub"
ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -N '' -f "$test_key"
install -d -m 0700 -o opsadmin -g opsadmin /home/opsadmin/.ssh
install -m 0600 -o opsadmin -g opsadmin "$test_key.pub" /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
adduser -D -s /bin/ash "$deny_user"
probe_created=1
probe_secret=[REDACTED]]] -An -N24 -tx1 /dev/urandom | tr -d ' \n')
printf '%s:%s\n' "$deny_user" "$probe_secret" | chpasswd >/dev/null
unset probe_secret
install -d -m 0700 -o "$deny_user" -g "$deny_user" "/home/$deny_user/.ssh"
install -m 0600 -o "$deny_user" -g "$deny_user" "$test_key.pub" "/home/$deny_user/.ssh/authorized_keys"
ssh_opts="-q -i $test_key -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o BatchMode=yes -o PasswordAuthentication=[REDACTED]]] -o KbdInteractiveAuthentication=no -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=5"
ssh $ssh_opts "opsadmin@$NODE_IP" 'printf "authenticated_user="; id -un; printf "authenticated_groups="; id -nG' > /tmp/ssh-allow-result 2>&1
set +e
ssh $ssh_opts "$deny_user@$NODE_IP" true > /tmp/ssh-deny-result 2>&1

set -e
printf '%s\n' 'allowed_member_login:'
cat /tmp/ssh-allow-result
printf 'nonmember_login_exit=%s\n' "$deny_rc"
printf '%s\n' 'nonmember_login_result:'
cat /tmp/ssh-deny-result
if [ "$deny_rc" -eq 0 ]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'ERROR: nonmember authenticated' >&2
  exit 1
fi
deluser --remove-home "$deny_user"
probe_created=0
rm -f "$test_key" "$test_key.pub" /tmp/ssh-allow-result /tmp/ssh-deny-result
rm -f /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
rmdir /home/opsadmin/.ssh
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
if id "$deny_user" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  printf '%s\n' 'ERROR: probe cleanup failed' >&2
  exit 1
fi
printf '%s\n' 'temporary_probe_artifacts_removed=yes'
